strategies.name: Spread edge 2.0+ (flat 1u)
strategies.description: Bet the side where the own line beats the market line by >= 2.0 points.

strategies.name: Spread edge 3.5+ (flat 1u)
strategies.description: High-conviction subset of S01: >= 3.5 points of disagreement.

strategies.name: Spread edge 2.0+ (quarter-Kelly)
strategies.description: Same entries as S01, staked with quarter-Kelly on the model win probability, capped at 4 units.

strategies.name: Weeks 1-4 spread edge 3.0+
strategies.description: Early-season subset: models may hold an information edge before the market has a full season of evidence.

strategies.name: Divisional games, edge 2.5+
strategies.description: Divisional rematches are the most-scouted games on the schedule; test whether the model's edge survives there.

strategies.name: Rest advantage 3+ days, edge 1.5+
strategies.description: Teams with a rest edge of at least three days, model edge >= 1.5.

strategies.name: Totals edge 2.5+ (flat 1u)
strategies.description: Over/under where the own total beats the market total by >= 2.5.

strategies.name: Totals edge 1.5+ (flat 1u)
strategies.description: Wider net on totals: >= 1.5 points of disagreement.

strategies.name: Under in windy outdoor games (wind >= 15 mph)
strategies.description: Every outdoor game with wind of at least 15 mph: bet the under at the real price.

strategies.name: Under on short rest (either team <= 4 days)
strategies.description: Short-week games suppress scoring: bet the under whenever either team has four days or less of rest.

strategies.name: Moneyline EV 5%+
strategies.description: Bet the moneyline side whose model win probability implies at least 5% expected value at the listed price.

strategies.name: Fade a 1.5+ point line move
strategies.description: When the closing line sits >= 1.5 points away from the opener, bet the side the market moved away from, at the closing price.

strategies.name: Follow a 1.5+ point line move
strategies.description: Same trigger, but bet with the move at the closing price - the momentum/steam hypothesis.

strategies.name: Model vs opening line, edge 2.0+
strategies.description: Bet at the opening line where the own line beats the opener by >= 2.0 points; the closing-line value column measures whether the market later moved toward the model.

strategies.name: Team-total derivative, edge 2.5+
strategies.description: Own team point projection vs the team total implied by the market spread and total. No sportsbook team-total price exists in the source, so the line is synthetic and the price is assumed.

strategies.name: Placebo control: random side every game
strategies.description: Coin flip on every game with a priced spread. Used to calibrate how much ROI variance is pure luck at this sample size.

strategies.name: Two-leg cross-game parlay (top 2 edges)
strategies.description: Each week, parlay the two largest spread disagreements. The parlay price is the product of the two real leg prices; sportsbooks do not publish this in the source data.

strategies.name: Three-leg cross-game parlay (top 3 edges)
strategies.description: Same rule with three legs; multiplication of three prices quadruples the variance of the outcome.

strategies.name: Same-game parlay: spread + total
strategies.description: Both legs must clear the same 2.0-point threshold. Priced as the independent product of the two leg prices - real books apply correlation pricing, which is not in the source data.

strategies.name: Same-game parlay: moneyline + total
strategies.description: Moneyline leg needs 4%+ model EV, total leg needs 2.0+ points of model edge. Independent-product pricing, as for P03.

blocked_props.name: QB passing yards, over/under
blocked_props.design: Project with a shrunk per-attempt rate x projected attempts (opponent pass-rate allowed, game script from the own spread). Bet when the projection beats the market prop line by >= 8%.
blocked_props.blocker: player-week passing outcomes and player prop prices are not available from any reachable source.
blocked_props.would_need: nflverse-data player_stats release (player, week, passing_yards) plus a sportsbook prop feed.

blocked_props.name: Receptions, over/under
blocked_props.design: Receptions are close to a Poisson process on target share x team pass volume. Model with a negative-binomial and bet only when the model tail probability differs from the implied prop probability by >= 6%.
blocked_props.blocker: player-week receiving outcomes are not available from any reachable source.

blocked_props.name: Prop combo: QB passing + own WR receiving (same game)
blocked_props.design: These legs are positively correlated through shared dropbacks, so the joint probability is far above the product of the leg probabilities. A combo should only be taken when the book's correlation pricing is worse than the empirical joint probability (see the analytic correlation model on the Correlation page).
blocked_props.blocker: needs both player-week outcomes and sportsbook same-game-parlay pricing.
blocked_props.would_need: player-week outcomes + an SGP price feed.
